_evidence: 0x0054a678 calls 0x54ba6b, which does 'mov al,[0x7aafd0]; inc al; and al,7; mov [0x7aafd0],al' (a 3-bit counter; the flags of the and are the output). 0x7aafd0 is read only by the callee and was never varied: any byte is valid (the and keeps it in 0..7 afterwards); the draws include 7 and 0xff so the wrap to 0 (ZF=1) occurs.
